rules.title: Security deposit cap (1.5x monthly rent)
rules.requirement: A landlord may not collect a security deposit of more than one and one-half times one month's rent. Pet deposits combined with the regular deposit, and prepaid rents held as security (including last month's rent), count toward the cap; the landlord may also require the first month's rent at lease inception.
rules.coverage_text: Most residential rental properties, including mobile homes; owner-occupied two- or three-family dwellings are excepted unless the tenant requests application.

exemption_tests.description: Owner-occupied two- or three-family dwelling (tenant may opt in 30 days after written request to landlord)

rules.exemptions_text: Owner-occupied two- or three-family dwelling, unless tenant sends written request and 30 days pass.
rules.quoted_span: The maximum-security deposit to be collected by the landlord cannot be more than one and one-half times one month’s rent ( N.J.S.A. 46:8-21.2 ).

rules.title: Annual security deposit increase limit (10%)
rules.requirement: Any additional yearly increase of a security deposit may not exceed 10% of the current security deposit.
rules.coverage_text: Most residential rental properties under the Security Deposit Law.

exemption_tests.description: Owner-occupied two- or three-family dwelling (tenant may opt in)

rules.exemptions_text: Owner-occupied two- or three-family dwelling unless tenant requests application.
rules.quoted_span: Any additional yearly security deposit increase may not exceed 10% of the current security deposit.
rules.key_value: 10% of current security deposit per year
rules.ambiguity_note: Citation for this sentence is not stated separately; it follows the cite to N.J.S.A. 46:8-21.2.

rules.title: Deposit must be held in trust in interest-bearing New Jersey account
rules.requirement: Security deposits remain the tenant's property, held in trust and not commingled with the landlord's assets. A landlord receiving deposits for ten or fewer units must place them in an insured New Jersey bank or S&L interest-bearing account; landlords with 10 or more units may use a money market fund or variable-rate account.
rules.coverage_text: Residential rentals under the Security Deposit Law; the holding provision does not apply to seasonal rentals.

exemption_tests.description: Seasonal use or rental (term of not more than 125 consecutive days by a person with a permanent residence elsewhere)
Owner-occupied two- or three-family dwelling (tenant may opt in)

rules.exemptions_text: Seasonal use or rental excepted from this section.
rules.quoted_span: A landlord or designee who receives security deposit money for ten or less units must deposit that money in an insured bank or savings and loan association located in New Jersey in an interest-bearing account at the current interest rate at the time of deposit.

rules.title: Interest on security deposit belongs to tenant
rules.requirement: Interest or earnings on the deposit belongs to the tenant and must be paid in cash or credited toward rent annually.
rules.coverage_text: Residential rentals under the Security Deposit Law.

exemption_tests.description: Owner-occupied two- or three-family dwelling (tenant may opt in)

rules.quoted_span: The interest or earnings paid on the security deposit belongs to the tenant

rules.title: Written notice of deposit location within 30 days
rules.requirement: Within 30 days of receiving the deposit, and with each annual interest payment, the landlord must notify the tenant in writing of the bank or investment company, amount, account type and interest rate. If notice or interest is not provided, the tenant may apply the deposit plus 7% interest to rent after giving written notice.
rules.coverage_text: Residential rentals under the Security Deposit Law.

exemption_tests.description: Owner-occupied two- or three-family dwelling (tenant may opt in)

rules.quoted_span: Within 30 days of receipt of the security deposit and at t he time of each annual interest payment, the landlord must notify the tenant in writing of the name and address of the banking institution or investment company in which the money is deposited, the amount of the deposit, type of account, and current rate o f interest for the account.
rules.penalty: Tenant may apply deposit plus 7% interest to rent

rules.title: Return of security deposit within 30 days of tenancy termination
rules.requirement: The landlord must return the deposit plus interest, less itemized deductions for damage beyond normal wear and tear or money owed under the lease, within 30 days after termination of the tenancy, by personal delivery or registered/certified mail. Failure allows the tenant to sue for double the amount wrongfully withheld plus costs and fees.
rules.coverage_text: Residential rentals under the Security Deposit Law.

exemption_tests.description: Owner-occupied two- or three-family dwelling (tenant may opt in)

rules.quoted_span: Within 30 days after the termination of a tenancy, a landlord must return the security deposit, plus interest earned less deductions, to the tenant
rules.penalty: Double the amount wrongfully withheld, plus court costs and reasonable attorney's fees

rules.title: Deposit return within 5 business days when tenant displaced
rules.requirement: When a tenant is displaced by fire, flood, condemnation or evacuation, the landlord must return the deposit within five business days and tell the tenant within three business days where it can be collected.
rules.coverage_text: Tenants displaced where an official has posted a notice prohibiting occupancy or certified displacement will exceed seven days.
rules.quoted_span: Within five (5) business days after a tenant is displaced by fire, flood, condemnation, or evacuation, the landlord must return the security deposit.

rules.title: Deposit return within 15 business days after domestic violence lease termination
rules.requirement: When a tenant terminates a lease under the Safe Housing Act, the landlord must make the deposit plus interest available within 15 business days, and give written notice within three business days of when and where it can be picked up, with an itemized list of interest and deductions.
rules.coverage_text: Tenants terminating leases under the New Jersey Safe Housing Act; does not apply to transient or seasonal rentals.
rules.exemptions_text: This law does not apply to transient or seasonal rentals.
rules.quoted_span: Within 15 business days after the lease  is terminated, the landlord shall make available the return of the tenant’s security deposit, plus any interest earned, to the tenant or the tenant’s agent.
